description: Use when you already asked a question with ask and want fresh records for it again: pass the reuse.id from that ask answer (and optionally since = the next_since from your last run to get only new or changed records). Re-runs the same verified datasets and filters with no AI, at the normal call price. Cheaper and faster than asking again.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 5 calls free within 48 hours).

since.description: Optional: next_since from your previous run.

name: rerun_question
title: Re-run a saved question for fresh records (no AI)
